text:
riya (PM): quick sync — Acme pushed for SSO + tenant isolation to be in MVP. urgent ask; they want pilot next month. can we realistically get SAML + per-tenant data isolation in the next milestone?

jamal (Eng): rough estimate: full tenant isolation is ~2 sprints (data + auth + infra). SAML integration itself is more like 2-3 weeks if we scope to a single IdP pattern. main blocker is the DB migration + multi-tenant ACL layer.

anna (Staff PM): options: 1) aggressive — include limited SAML + feature-flagged tenant isolation (partial) in MVP, 2) pragmatic — ship OAuth + deferred full isolation to v1, 3) cut — defer SSO entirely for MVP and offer hosted onboarding. need to weigh customer risk vs ship risk.

lucas (Design): UX note — SAML flows + tenant admin screens will need at least 1 sprint of design + 1 sprint dev to polish. If we do a minimal flow (email + magic link fallback) we can shorten that. also need copy for enterprise consent screens.

maria (SRE): capacity note — per-tenant isolation requires scoped caching and backups. rolling this without infra automation increases oncall risk. if we compress timeline we should enable a strict fallback and monitoring (SLOs + tracing). storage migration plan required.

chris (Eng-Platform): pragmatic path I've done before: ship SAML as an optional integration (no per-tenant data split) behind a feature flag + strict guardrails, then run Acme on a dedicated instance for pilot (reduces migration risk). fallback: if isolation fails, toggle flag and route them to hosted preview. we can wire rollout via existing canary pipeline.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window available Wed 05:30 UTC -> risk window small. :white_check_mark:

riya (PM): proposal based on feedback: include "SAML-lite" in MVP (single IdP, no admin UI), run Acme on a dedicated preview environment for pilot, defer tenant admin + analytics to v1. timeline impact: +1 sprint for stabilization and infra hardening.

jamal (Eng): ack. deliverables for SAML-lite: 1) SAML assertion consumer endpoint + minimal mapping, 2) feature flag toggle, 3) dedicated preview infra runbook. estimate ~3 weeks dev + 1 week hardening.

anna (Staff PM): sounds reasonable. trade-offs documented. i'll update the PRD and add a canary + rollback criteria: failure -> disable SAML flag and revert to OAuth by next deploy.

lucas (Design): i'll scope a 1-week design spike for the SAML screens and provide copy.

maria (SRE): i'll prep the backup/migration checklist and SLO dashboard; need at least one oncall shadow during pilot.

chris (Eng-Platform): i'll create the rollout plan in the release doc and add automated toggles.

riya (PM): votes? react with :thumbsup: if you agree with this trimmed MVP path, :thumbsdown: if you want full SSO+isolation now. planning to lock scope EOD today and update roadmap.

(Anna) :thumbsup:
(jamal) :thumbsup:
(lucas) :thumbsup:
(maria) :thumbsup:
(chris) :thumbsup:

riya (PM): great — locking this. i'll send updated timeline to Acme and schedule a stakeholder sync for tomorrow 10am PT. thanks all.
